title: The Periodic Table as a Measured Object: Tier-1 Derivation from Atomic Properties in the GCD Kernel
source_native_claims: Treats all 118 elements as one fixed measured object under a frozen 8-channel atomic closure and asks what structure the GCD/UMCP kernel recovers from standard atomic properties alone.
The paper does not attempt to replace chemistry; its distinct burden is to make the entire table answerable as one explicit measured object under one published comparison surface.
Under the frozen closure all 118 rows satisfy the identities F+ω=1, IC≤F, IC=e^κ; at corpus scale 111 rows are in Collapse, 7 in Watch, 0 in Stable.
